title: ChronicleCore Architecture: Design Archive of a Governed Multi-Agent Expert System
description:
Design archive of ChronicleCore, a multi-agent expert system of 39 persona-based agents governed by a human Sovereign. Documents are published in English and Traditional Chinese.

Version 3.0 (2026-09-26) adds:

  • Eras: the system's history from the Antigravity prototypes through Chronicle-Ark to the Empire generation (2025-11 to 2026-09).
  • System: a concept-level description of the Empire generation's architecture (canon authority, leases, rooms, switchable model backends, identity module v2).
  • Infrastructure: measured hardware, GPU configuration, and relationships between machines as of 2026-09-26, including local vLLM coordination on a dual RTX 3090 workstation.
  • Chronicles: the birth of Kagami, the first agent created natively in identity structure 2.0.

Earlier states of this repository (tags v1.0-whitepaper and v2.0-asaf) are cited in the ASAF paper, to which this archive is supplementary. Detailed specifications that are not published are committed by SHA-256 hashes listed in the documents.
